summary: The proposal is well-positioned for submission and has only minor issues identified by the review groups. It should be strengthened by separating the workaround from the Problem section, clarifying omitted actors in passive constructions, and standardizing terminology for the platform.

findings.title: Keep the workaround out of the Problem section
findings.description: The Problem section introduces an existing workaround or alternative, although this section should focus on the underlying problem and its negative consequences. Remove the workaround or recast it solely as a consequence of the access-management problem.

locations.quote: The **common workaround hands maintainers full administrative rights**, which violates the principle of least privilege [SS75] and exposes every user and every host to a mistake made for a single project.

findings.title: Make omitted actors explicit in reduced passive constructions
findings.description: Several reduced passive constructions omit the actor. Identify who performs each action and use active formulations, such as “the chair grants access for one project,” “the connectors bind leaves to target systems,” and “I write the webhook connector after freezing the framework.”

locations.quote: and **access granted for one project** outlives the time a person spends at the chair.

locations.section: Unify Heterogeneous Resources in One Tree
locations.quote: I model the resources as a tree whose folders pass maintainership, audit policy, and grants down to **leaves bound to target systems**

locations.section: Unify Heterogeneous Resources in One Tree
locations.quote: I reach this objective when the webhook connector, **written after I freeze the framework**, needs one new class and one registry entry.

findings.title: Use consistent terminology for the platform
findings.description: The proposal uses both “self-service platform” and “access management platform” for the same system. Choose one canonical term and use it consistently, or explicitly define the relationship between the two terms.

locations.quote: In this thesis, I develop a **self-service platform** on which every grant carries an expiry date from the moment somebody requests it.
